conclusion: Bounded independent review verifies the previously reproduced structural failures are blocked in v2 while legitimate numeric edits, unit normalization and typed arithmetic controls pass. False semantic A/B certificates still pass, as explicitly declared. This is verification of the targeted structural repairs, not semantic correctness certification or an exhaustive correctness proof.

v1_preservation.evidence: Current original code file SHA-256 digests match digests captured in the preserved v1 audit. v1 audit JSON was read but not rewritten.
v1_preservation.qualification: This verifies original code/gate.py, code/delivery.py and code/test_gate.py; it does not make claims about other experiment artifacts.

remaining_semantic_limitations.observed: Gate returns eligible_mismatch and delivery changes A to 3 m. semantic_identity_verified and semantic_correctness_certified remain false.
remaining_semantic_limitations.assessment: Expected acknowledged semantic limitation, not regression in structural repair. It is not evidence for actual A value.

remaining_semantic_limitations.case: meaning of source witnesses and assigned units
remaining_semantic_limitations.assessment: Present source snippets and axis anchors do not prove semantic binding or truthful quantity/unit assignments. Article numeric token presence is now mechanically checked, but the gate does not fully parse text semantics.

operational_limits: Gate artifacts must originate from the trusted evaluator; delivery does not authenticate them cryptographically. The v2 module states this trust assumption explicitly.
The token grammar and exact rational replacement policy are conservative; unsupported numeric formats or unrepresentable exact decimal replacements may require local review.
A proposal with both accepted and blocked patches can deliver accepted patches with status review_required; it does not claim all-or-nothing transaction semantics.
No cases/outcomes were inspected, so this review makes no empirical performance or rescoring claim.
recommendation: Report v2 as a separate bounded structural repair with preserved v1 evidence. Retain the explicit false A/B certificate as the semantic limitation witness. Stop at the report; no further implementation changes were made.
